short: Tracking groups of customers who started in the same period.
seoTitle: Cohort Analysis — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: Cohort analysis groups customers by when they first bought and tracks each group's behaviour over time. Blended averages hide direction.
definition: Cohort analysis groups customers by when they first bought and tracks each group's behaviour over time. It shows whether recent customers behave better or worse than earlier ones.
bodyHtml:
Why Cohort Analysis matters

Blended averages hide direction. A retention figure can stay flat while every new cohort performs worse, because the older cohorts are still propping it up.

How Cohort Analysis works in practice

Compare month-one, month-three and month-six repeat rates across cohorts. A deteriorating pattern usually means the channel bringing customers in has changed, not the product.

faq.question: How many cohorts do I need?
faq.answer: Six months of monthly cohorts is enough to see direction in most small businesses.

faq.question: What does a declining cohort mean?
faq.answer: Usually a change in acquisition source or an operational drift, and it appears in cohorts long before it appears in totals.
